[Abstracted Experience Guidance]
- Principle 1: Keep train/test isolation and train-fitted transformations for all regression variants to avoid leakage.
- Principle 2: Pair feature relevance selection with out-of-sample error checking, because training fit alone can hide poor generalization.
- Decision rationale: Regression model choice should be driven by held-out error behavior rather than in-sample score.
- Switch condition: If residuals show strong nonlinearity or heteroscedasticity, move to a more robust/flexible regressor; otherwise keep a simpler baseline.
- Caution: Frequent failures include overfitting via overly complex models and reporting only training metrics.

[Target Task]
I have a dataset {parkinsons_updrs.csv}, the "Target" column is the predicted result, please use ordinal regression to perform regression training on this dataset.
